environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following configuration: (1) AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode for logging, (2) a custom rule with priority 1 that inspects the request Body with a SizeConstraint of 10MB and a RegexPatternSet match on the raw body bytes looking for sequences matching the pattern '\x2e\x2e\x2f' and '\x2e\x2e\x5c' (URL-decoded dot-dot-slash/backslash in binary), with action BLOCK and a custom response code 403, (3) the WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the WAFv2 WebACL has a rule group reference statement using 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in BLOCK mode, which includes the 'JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY' and 'Log4JRCE_BODY' rules but also inspects for path traversal sequences in multipart bodies. The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: false but the ECS task definition specifies a tmpfs mount at /var/data/uploads with size 512MB.

config.runtime: AWS ECS Fargate, Spring Boot 3.1.5, JDK 17
config.network: ALB -> WAFv2 WebACL -> Target Group -> ECS Task (port 8080)

rules.name: BlockPathTraversalInBody
rules.statement: ByteMatchStatement on Body with transforms [URL_DECODE, BASE64_DECODE] matching '../' and '..\'

config.iam: ecsTaskRole with basic CloudWatch and ECR permissions
